title: TNF-alpha and NF-kB Crosstalk in Drug-Resistant Breast Cancer
text: Tumor necrosis factor alpha activates NF-kB signaling, which contributes to drug resistance in breast cancer cells. We observed that TNF-alpha-treated cells exhibit increased expression of multidrug resistance pumps and anti-apoptotic proteins. However, our findings conflict with earlier reports that TNF-alpha sensitizes tumor cells to chemotherapy. This inconsistency may be explained by differences in tumor microenvironment context. Future work should clarify the conditions under which TNF-alpha promotes versus inhibits drug resistance.
